performance_scope: Fixed40, paced480Move longerase, immediate twofinger viewportpan/pinch atDPR2, normalSDK. DPR4 correctness and timing descriptive only.

definitions.origin: First planned nonzero twofinger Move after Up; record planned, actual dispatch, completion, first cameraGeneration change separately. Also record Up-return to firstcorrect feedback.
definitions.first_feedback: Actual content submission to intended display target at changed camera, carrying current pending erase suffix or committed equivalent; not input acceptance, overlay-only GL, clear-only GL, oldcamera or emptybuffer.
definitions.maximum_gap: Longest interval from origin to first qualified content submission, between successive currentcamera valid feedback submissions, and last submission to inputend. Do not count repeated stalecamera writes.
definitions.frame_p95: Nearest-rank ceil(.95*N) percentile of SDK rAF start intervals during primary navigation including initial delay. Also report callback durations, inputlateness and worst interval.
definitions.cross_lane: Ordinary GL content submission timings are a proxy; correctness/native route+identity/content conjunction qualifies applicability, not per-frame photon proof. Diagnostic/readback/heldWorker timings never pool into ordinary.

blocking_primary_targets.cases: Each primary immediate pan and pinch, both ordinary C replicates, start includes planned-time scheduling delay. If cannot meet, report target UNMET; no lowering after measurement.

nonregression.post_input_convergence_median: C <= max(B*1.15,B+50ms); disclose maxima and full Up->commit->visible times
nonregression.memory: Keep existing same B/C profile. Added retained geometry/pixels must be accounted once, pins retired safely; no RSS-derived fake GPU accounting.

pixel_rules: Independent original body and sequential per-object legacy mask reference; erased interior/no-resurrection/zorder/opacity exact. Existing independently defined contour-edge AA policy unchanged (channel2 only where already authorized); do not mask whole tiles or enlarge tolerances. Approximate navigation may resample, so interior/world-transform/content witnesses plus exact terminal full-frame oracle; do not demand approximate pixels byteequal to final exact at edges.
claim_limits: Ordinary renderer submission is not physical input-to-photon.
A native/qualification scenario held Worker delivery is correctness-only.
aggregation: Nearest-rank percentiles over pooled raw samples for each role/case; also retain per-replicate rows. Max-content-gap comparison uses worst maximum over repeats, never median of maxima. Each primary C replicate must satisfy absolute bounds.
normal_observer: Use exact prior v2 observer as reference: state cached at SDK RAF/input boundaries, no SDK/readState/JSON/reentrant work inside GL draw wrappers. Required native/correctness tests separately establish real current-target/content applicability. No hidden forced frames.
